subject.title: Feishu: @mention not recognized in group when multiple bots share the same group (open_id app-scoped mismatch)

question: Which Feishu bot identity strategy should become canonical for multi-bot group @mention admission when Feishu open_id values are app-scoped?
rationale: The bug path is clear in source, but choosing union_id, cross-app open_id collection, app-id mapping, or a documented limitation changes Feishu message-admission behavior and cannot be selected safely by cleanup automation alone.

options.title: Prove And Land Stable Identity
options.body: Rework the linked PR or a replacement around a verified Feishu identity source and cover text, post, command, mention-forward, debounce, and live multi-bot behavior.

options.title: Document Feishu Limitation
options.body: If Feishu exposes no reliable cross-app bot identity, keep mention admission conservative and document the supported multi-bot workaround.

options.title: Fold Into Broader Feishu Multi-Bot Design
options.body: Handle this with the wider Feishu multi-bot identity/session work only if maintainers want one combined design for admission, routing, and context isolation.

recommendation.title: Prove And Land Stable Identity
recommendation.body: Rework the linked PR or a replacement around a verified Feishu identity source and cover text, post, command, mention-forward, debounce, and live multi-bot behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The package metadata names this handle as the Feishu/Lark plugin ownership signal, and the decision is specific to Feishu bot identity behavior.
